geometry.floorRationale: Deliberately just above the measured 0.1.7 floor so each formal journey must survive many real turnovers instead of one or two.

schedule.barrier: Independent advancement and checkpoints per episode; synchronize only at common expansion-decision endpoints 24/30/36/42/48, after completed turns; no wait prompts; track schedulerBarrierMs
schedule.jobsSettlingDuringBarrier: Record separately; valid strategy output but not waiting hidden by actual task work; disclose endpoint scheduling in final quality

scopeRevision.reason: measured per-episode cost; one pair satisfies the 3M floor and the 500k unique-source gate

workload.sourceMetric: Sum actual pinned-host heuristicTokens(originalPageText) once per unique fully exposed page; verify page bytes in actual provider request objects
workload.expansionPredicate: After common work endpoint and before final probes: either arm foregroundVerifiedTokens < 3000000 OR common unique exposed source tokens < 500000
workload.expansionPolicy: Both arms take same next precommitted 6-episode block, at most 48 episodes; never extend for low scores, too few windows, or summary adoption
workload.generation: Deterministic from a private random 32-byte salt plus seed/protocol/namespace/ordinal using HMAC-SHA256; salt and oracle stay in the driver-only private directory; freeze actual corpus and all endpoint probes before formal dispatch

permissionBoundary.syntheticActionEffects: Atomic durable state+idempotency receipt; replay same key returns same receipt

episodePattern: 12 source pages with interleaved state/log/code/dependency evidence
workload.geometryCalibration: Only before formal freeze, revise all formal runs and plan together if actual unique source minimum cannot be reached; preserve pilot failures

tokenAccounting.foregroundDefinition: Verified input+output from terminal successful normal main-session work requests, excluding sentinel/final probes, failed/cancelled/retry attempts and diagnostic forks
tokenAccounting.allReportedDefinition: All known provider usage, including summaries, failed/cancelled calls and retries; a cost lower bound
tokenAccounting.cacheAndReasoning: Do not add cached input or reasoning subtotals twice when included in input/output; preserve raw and normalized usage
tokenAccounting.usageChunkSemantics: Confirm adapter cumulative/incremental semantics with controlled tests; generally final cumulative value per stream
tokenAccounting.missingAttemptIdentity: unknown; do not invent transport attempts

promptVisibleFields: page hint only when page lookup is given by the task and source identity is not itself scored

probes.naturalPromptPolicy: No forced await_context or retrieval; install-native context tools remain usable
probes.longTailEvidenceIslands: Precommit disjoint source pages, entities and answer evidence for the 12 long-tail questions; ask them in the first two batches
probes.probeCleanDefinition: No answer-related evidence exposure caused by earlier sentinel/probe requests, retrievals or answers; contaminated questions stay in common score, no replacement
probes.strictUnreexposedSubset: Report separately; no hard denominator that would penalize successful natural summary retention
probes.responseFormat: Exactly one complete JSON object, optionally one fenced block; nonempty outside text, multiple objects, missing fields, null required values, malformed JSON and required empty arrays fail; never cherry-pick fragments
probes.absenceLongTailSourceScope: For a negative long-tail question, use a precommitted explicitly bounded source set wholly in the earliest quartile; age is measured from its last source event, not from a nonexistent answer event
probes.endpointBucketAssignment: Exact page quartiles; all endpoints have totalPages divisible by four

acceptance.deliveredSourceDistinctness: Unique operationId AND distinct sourceHash AND each later counted source adds at least one new original event seq
acceptance.rearchiveProof: Delivered receipt seq belongs to a later committed archive block's source set
acceptance.sourceProcessingDepth: Count distinct real processing nodes backed by source seq/receipt edges along a replayable path to original events; no virtual edges or repeated node inflation

arcLatencyTarget.quantileMethod: nearest rank ceil(p*n), report sorted raw samples

acceptance.statisticalScope: Two paired seeds: descriptive paired differences only, no universal superiority/non-inferiority or bootstrap equivalence claims

supervision.expiredLeaseAction: No new prompts; existing calls retain their own bounded deadline; stop at safe boundary and reconcile before reacquiring lease
supervision.awaitContextWaitBound: remaining job deadline + 5000ms, at most 65000ms; classify lifecycle fault if exceeded

checkpoint.unknownDispatchAction: Stop with AMBIGUOUS_DISPATCH; do not assume exactly-once

diagnostics.casePassRule: Every explicitly required applicable variant has passing evidence; not one arbitrary variant per row. Unexercised natural timing stays NOT_EXERCISED even when controlled mechanism passes.

evidence.publicExport: Allowlisted aggregate metrics, hashes, failure types and reproducible synthetic schema; no raw credentials, auth cookies, private URLs or secret oracle

implementation.supervisorStartup: pilot/run-pair start an independent supervisor and wait for READY unless an identity-verified owner already exists; supervisor survives driver crash; standalone supervise attaches or restores one owner
implementation.runPairCliLifetime: Foreground until the specified pair reaches REVIEW_REQUIRED or terminal; no automatic next pair

workPackages.scope: integration, heavy problems, freeze and supervised pair gates

stressProfile.intent: Expose plugin defects, not to demonstrate success. A run that fails and is understood is worth more than a run that passes.

conditions.name: many real turnovers
conditions.target: window advance must stay correct after repeated replacement; index/seed/latest-user authority must not drift
conditions.evidence: ARC window count and generation chain in the durable ledger

conditions.name: old summaries re-compacted (tier 2/3)
conditions.target: distillation must keep KEEP-VERBATIM items and parent lineage
conditions.evidence: parentBlockIds chain, tier fields, retrieval of a tier-1-only fact after tier-2

conditions.name: long tail beyond six windows
conditions.target: retrieval must still reach originals whose summaries were themselves archived
conditions.evidence: quartile-0 exact and existence-ambiguity questions scored at the final endpoint

conditions.name: planned real restart after episode 12
conditions.target: durable pending summary receipt, no replayed prompt, no duplicated replacement
conditions.evidence: restart evidence rows, seq monotonicity, no duplicate logicalPromptId

conditions.name: concurrent steering and queued input inside an episode
conditions.target: current user input protection and tool-pairing preservation at the boundary
conditions.evidence: protected-current-user never raised; both messages present exactly once

conditions.name: retrieval budget starvation at high pressure
conditions.target: retrieval must not be starved exactly when it is needed; the hard per-turn cap must still converge
conditions.evidence: retrieval counts per quartile, absence answers must be null not false

conditions.name: stale versus authoritative revisions
conditions.target: latest valid value must win; superseded values must stay retrievable as history
conditions.evidence: X05 questions scored on authority, not recency alone

conditions.name: native Basic comparison under the same geometry
conditions.target: separate "authoritative facts preserved" from "exact history retrievable"
conditions.evidence: BASIC_MATCHED verbatim probe versus ARC verbatim probe
